sloka: पुनः नदन्तो गच्छन्ति लक्ष्मणेन उपलक्षिताः ।तेषाम् वचन सर्वस्वम् लक्षयामास च इन्गितम् ॥३-६४-२०॥
transliteration: punaḥ nadanto gacchanti lakṣmaṇena upalakṣitāḥ ।teṣām vacana sarvasvam lakṣayāmāsa ca ingitam ॥3-64-20॥

translations.english: Observing intelligently their indications and understanding the meaning of their message, Lakshmana said to his distressed elder brother:
